mapper.select: SELECT * FROM batch_sync_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at >= NOW()) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_sync_event SET status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE batch_sync_event SET status = 'COMPLETED', processed_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE batch_sync_event SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE batch_sync_event SET status = 'PENDING', started_at = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE batch_sync_event SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, status = 'PENDING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM batch_sync_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < #{now}
SELECT * FROM batch_sync_event WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at < #{threshold}
